steps.message: Execute: adb shell "cmd wifi help >/dev/null 2>&1; cmd wifi set-wifi-enabled enabled >/dev/null 2>&1 || svc wifi enable; cmd wifi status 2>/dev/null || dumpsys wifi | grep -i 'Wi-Fi is' -m 1"

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell "cmd wifi help >/dev/null 2>&1; cmd wifi set-wifi-enabled enabled >/dev/null 2>&1 || svc wifi enable; cmd wifi status 2>/dev/null || dumpsys wifi | grep -i 'Wi-Fi is' -m 1""
